title: Authority Schema
description: The ability to make valid decisions, assertions, or grants (Vol 1 §13; Vol 2 §3). Authority MUST have provenance: it is a traceable chain of origin/delegation, not mere possession - possession without lineage is not authority (CORE-INVARIANT 11). So issuer, subject, scope, and derives_from (the lineage) are required. Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4.

issuer.description: object-ref id of who conferred this authority.

subject.description: object-ref id of who holds it.

scope.description: the bounded domain the authority applies to (authority is not universal, Vol 2 §4).

derives_from.description: the lineage: ownership | delegation | role | policy | external-trust, or an object-ref to the parent authority (invariant 11).
